identification: Mahogany (or mahogany-stained hardwood) wind-out extension dining table in Victorian style: rounded-corner moulded top in two halves plus leaves (photo 5 shows it extended, about 218 cm; photos 2-4 closed, about 140-150 cm), plain apron, four baluster-turned legs on brass cup castors, brass winder keyhole escutcheon on the end apron (photo 5). Winder handle not pictured. Top is multi-board, very even reddish colour with a high-gloss modern finish and crisp arrises: looks like a late 20th century reproduction or a fully refinished later table rather than an untouched c1880 one.
